units.zh: 酈生食其者，陳留高陽人也。
units.en: Li Yiji was a man of Gaoyang in Chenliu.
units.literal: Li Sheng Shiqi was from Gaoyang in Chenliu.

units.zh: 好讀書，家貧落魄，無以為衣食業，為里監門吏。
units.en: He loved reading, but his family was destitute. Unable to earn a living, he took a position as a gatekeeper in his village.
units.literal: He was fond of reading books. His family was poor and downfallen, with nothing to make a living providing clothing and food, so he became the neighborhood gate watch official.

units.zh: 然縣中賢豪不敢役，縣中皆謂之狂生。
units.en: However, the county's worthy nobles did not dare employ him. Everyone in the county called him the mad scholar.
units.literal: However, the county's worthy and powerful did not dare employ him. Everyone in the county called him the mad scholar.

units.zh: 及陳勝、項梁等起，諸將徇地過高陽者數十人，酈生聞其將皆握齱好苛禮自用，不能聽大度之言，酈生乃深自藏匿。
units.en: When Chen Sheng, Xiang Liang, and the other rebel leaders rose up, dozens of generals passed through Gaoyang while seizing territory. Li Yiji heard that these generals were all petty men fond of rigid etiquette who acted on their own judgment and could not tolerate broad-minded counsel, so he went deep into hiding.
units.literal: When Chen Sheng, Xiang Liang, and others rose up, dozens of generals who were seizing territory passed through Gaoyang. Li Sheng heard that their generals were all petty and cramped, fond of harsh etiquette, self-willed, and unable to listen to broad-minded words. Li Sheng then hid himself away deeply.

units.zh: 後聞沛公將兵略地陳留郊，沛公麾下騎士適酈生裏中子也，沛公時時問邑中賢士豪俊。
units.en: Later he heard that the Lord of Pei was leading troops to seize territory in the Chenliu suburbs. A cavalryman under the Lord of Pei's banner happened to be a son from Li Yiji's neighborhood. The Lord of Pei frequently asked about the worthy scholars and outstanding men of the district.
units.literal: Later he heard that the Lord of Pei was leading troops to seize territory in the suburbs of Chenliu. A cavalryman under the Lord of Pei's banner happened to be a son from Li Yiji's neighborhood. The Lord of Pei frequently asked about the worthy scholars and outstanding heroes in the district.

units.zh: 騎士歸，酈生見謂之曰：「吾聞沛公慢而易人，多大略，此真吾所願從游，莫為我先。
units.en: When the cavalryman returned, Li Sheng met him and said: "I have heard that Pei Gong is arrogant but treats people easily, with many great strategies. This is truly someone I wish to follow and travel with. There is no one to introduce me first."
units.literal: The cavalryman returned. Li Sheng met him and told him: "I have heard Pei Gong is arrogant but easy with people, and has many great strategies. This truly is what I wish to follow and travel with. There is no one to introduce me first.

units.zh: 若見沛公，謂曰『臣里中有酈生，年六十餘，長八尺，人皆謂之狂生，生自謂我非狂生』。」
units.en: If you see the Lord of Pei, tell him: 'In my neighborhood there is Li Yiji, over sixty years old and eight chi tall. People all call him the mad scholar, but I myself say I am not a mad scholar.'"
units.literal: If you see Pei Gong, tell him: 'In my neighborhood there is Li Sheng, age sixty plus, height eight chi, people all call him mad scholar, but Sheng himself says I am not a mad scholar.'"

units.zh: 騎士曰：「沛公不好儒，諸客冠儒冠來者，沛公輒解其冠，溲溺其中。
units.en: The cavalryman said: 'Pei Gong is not fond of Confucians. Whenever guests wearing Confucian caps come, Pei Gong promptly loosens their caps and urinates in them.
units.literal: The cavalryman said: 'Pei Gong is not fond of Confucians. Whenever guests come wearing Confucian caps, Pei Gong promptly loosens their caps and urinates into them.

units.zh: 與人言，常大罵。
units.en: When he speaks with people, he often curses freely.
units.literal: When speaking with people, he often curses greatly.

units.zh: 未可以儒生說也。」
units.en: One cannot yet persuade him with a Confucian scholar.'
units.literal: Not yet can with Confucian scholar persuade.'

units.zh: 酈生曰：「弟言之。」
units.en: Li Yiji said: 'Younger brother, go and tell him.'
units.literal: Li Yiji said: 'Younger brother, go tell him.'

units.zh: 騎士從容言如酈生所誡者。
units.en: The cavalryman calmly delivered the message just as Li Yiji had instructed him.
units.literal: The cavalryman leisurely spoke as Li Sheng had warned him to.

units.zh: 沛公至高陽傳舍，使人召酈生。
units.en: When the Lord of Pei reached the relay station at Gaoyang, he sent someone to summon Li Yiji.
units.literal: Pei Gong arrived at the Gao Yang relay lodge and sent someone to summon Li Sheng.

units.zh: 酈生至，入謁，沛公方倨床使兩女子洗足，而見酈生。
units.en: When Li Yiji arrived and entered to present himself, the Lord of Pei was lounging on a bed with his legs spread wide, having two serving women wash his feet, and he received Li Yiji in that posture.
units.literal: Li Sheng arrived and entered to announce himself. Pei Gong was just sitting arrogantly on the bed having two women wash his feet, and he received Li Sheng.

units.zh: 酈生入，則長揖不拜，曰：「足下欲助秦攻諸侯乎？
units.en: Li Sheng entered, then gave a long bow without kneeling, and said: 'Your excellency, do you wish to help Qin attack the feudal lords?
units.literal: Li Sheng entered, then long bow not bow, said: 'Your excellency wish help Qin attack feudal lords?

units.zh: 且欲率諸侯破秦也？」
units.en: Or do you mean to lead the feudal lords in breaking Qin?'
units.literal: Or do you wish to lead the feudal lords to destroy Qin?'

units.zh: 沛公罵曰：「豎儒！
units.en: The Lord of Pei cursed: 'You worthless scholar!
units.literal: The Lord of Pei cursed and said: 'Worthless scholar!

units.zh: 夫天下同苦秦久矣，故諸侯相率而攻秦，何謂助秦攻諸侯乎？」
units.en: Indeed, the whole realm has long suffered under Qin, which is why the feudal lords are joining together to attack Qin. How can you speak of helping Qin attack the feudal lords?'
units.literal: Indeed all under heaven together suffered Qin long time, therefore feudal lords mutually lead and attack Qin, how can say help Qin attack feudal lords?'

units.zh: 酈生曰：「必聚徒合義兵誅無道秦，不宜倨見長者。」
units.en: Li Sheng said: 'You must gather followers and assemble righteous troops to execute the lawless Qin. It is not proper to arrogantly receive elders.'
units.literal: Li Sheng said: 'Must gather followers assemble righteous troops execute lawless Qin, not proper arrogantly see elders.'

units.zh: 於是沛公輟洗，起攝衣，延酈生上坐，謝之。
units.en: At this, the Lord of Pei stopped the washing, rose and straightened his robes, invited Li Yiji to the seat of honor, and offered his apologies.
units.literal: Thereupon, Pei Gong stopped washing, rose, adjusted his clothes, invited Li Sheng to the upper seat, and apologized to him.

units.zh: 酈生因言六國從橫時。
units.en: Li Yiji then spoke of the era of the Six States and their shifting alliances.
units.literal: Li Sheng then spoke of the time of the Six States' vertical and horizontal alliances.

units.zh: 沛公喜，賜酈生食，問曰：「計將安出？」
units.en: The Lord of Pei was pleased. He bestowed food on Li Yiji and asked, 'What plan do you propose?'
units.literal: The Lord of Pei was pleased, bestowed food upon Li Yiji, and asked: 'What is your plan?'

units.zh: 酈生曰：「足下起糾合之眾，收散亂之兵，不滿萬人，欲以徑入彊秦，此所謂探虎口者也。
units.en: Li Sheng said: 'Your excellency has raised a gathered multitude and collected scattered troops, not even ten thousand men, yet wishes to directly enter the strong Qin. This is what is called probing the tiger's mouth.
units.literal: Li Sheng said: 'Your excellency raised gathered multitude, collected scattered troops, not full ten thousand persons, wishes with directly enter strong Qin, this called probe tiger mouth ones.

units.zh: 夫陳留，天下之衝，四通五達之郊也，今其城又多積粟。
units.en: Indeed, Chenliu is the realm's great thoroughfare, where roads from all directions converge. Its city also has great stores of accumulated grain.
units.literal: Indeed Chenliu, all under heaven's thoroughfare, four directions five ways reached suburbs, now its city moreover much accumulated grain.

units.zh: 臣善其令，請得使之，令下足下。
units.en: I am on good terms with the magistrate there. Allow me to go as your envoy and persuade him to surrender to you.
units.literal: I am on good terms with its magistrate. I request to be allowed to go and make him submit to your excellency.

units.zh: 即不聽，足下舉兵攻之，臣為內應。」
units.en: If he does not listen, your excellency can raise troops to attack him, and I will act as an inside agent.'
units.literal: If not listen, your excellency raise troops attack it, I will be internal responder.'

units.zh: 於是遣酈生行，沛公引兵隨之，遂下陳留。
units.en: Li Yiji was dispatched accordingly. The Lord of Pei led his troops behind him, and they soon took Chenliu.
units.literal: Thereupon, Li Sheng was dispatched. Pei Gong led his troops to follow him, and they subsequently took Chenliu.

units.zh: 號酈食其為廣野君。
units.en: Li Yiji was given the title Lord of Guangye.
units.literal: Li Shiqi was then titled Lord Guangye.

units.zh: 酈生言其弟酈商，使將數千人從沛公西南略地。
units.en: Li Yiji recommended his younger brother Li Shang, who was given command of several thousand men to follow the Lord of Pei southwest and seize territory.
units.literal: Li Sheng then spoke of his younger brother, Li Shang, and had him lead several thousand men to follow Pei Gong southwest to plunder territory.

units.zh: 酈生常為說客，馳使諸侯。
units.en: Li Yiji regularly served as a persuader, riding swiftly on missions to the feudal lords.
units.literal: Li Sheng often served as a persuader, traveling rapidly to various feudal lords.

units.zh: 漢三年秋，項羽擊漢，拔滎陽，漢兵遁保鞏、洛。
units.en: In the autumn of the third year of Han, Xiang Yu attacked Han and took Xingyang. The Han forces retreated to hold Gong and Luo.
units.literal: In the autumn of Han's third year, Xiang Yu attacked Han, capturing Xingyang. Han forces fled to defend Gong and Luo.

units.zh: 楚人聞淮陰侯破趙，彭越數反梁地，則分兵救之。
units.en: When the Chu forces heard that the Marquis of Huaiyin had defeated Zhao and that Peng Yue was raiding Liang territory repeatedly, they divided their troops to deal with these threats.
units.literal: The Chu people heard that the Marquis of Huaiyin had defeated Zhao and that Peng Yue had repeatedly rebelled in Liang territory, so they divided their troops to relieve it.

units.zh: 淮陰方東擊齊，漢王數困滎陽、成皋，計欲捐成皋以東，屯鞏、洛以拒楚。
units.en: The Marquis of Huaiyin was then striking east against Qi. The King of Han had been in dire straits at Xingyang and Chenggao time and again, and was planning to abandon Chenggao and all the territory east of it, garrisoning Gong and Luo to resist Chu.
units.literal: Huaiyin was just attacking Qi to the east. The King of Han was repeatedly in distress at Xingyang and Chenggao, and planned to abandon Chenggao and the territory to its east, garrisoning Gong and Luo to resist Chu.

units.zh: 酈生因曰：「臣聞知天之天者，王事可成；
units.en: Li Sheng then said: 'I have heard that he who understands the heaven of Heaven can accomplish the king's affairs;
units.literal: Li Sheng then said: 'I heard he who knows heaven's heaven, king's affairs can be accomplished;

units.zh: 不知天之天者，王事不可成。
units.en: he who does not understand the heaven of Heaven cannot accomplish the king's affairs.
units.literal: He who does not know the heaven of Heaven cannot accomplish the king's affairs.

units.zh: 王者以民人為天，而民人以食為天。
units.en: The king takes the people as his heaven, and the people take food as their heaven.
units.literal: The king takes the people as heaven, and the people take food as heaven.

units.zh: 夫敖倉，天下轉輸久矣，臣聞其下乃有藏粟甚多。
units.en: Indeed, Aocang has long been the empire's transport hub. I hear that below it there is a vast amount of stored grain.
units.literal: Indeed Aocang, all under heaven's transport long time, I heard below it actually has stored grain very much.

units.zh: 楚人拔滎陽，不堅守敖倉，乃引而東，令適卒分守成皋，此乃天所以資漢也。
units.en: The Chu people took Xingyang but did not firmly defend Aocang. Instead, they withdrew eastward, ordering suitable troops to divide and defend Chenggao. This is truly Heaven's way of assisting Han.
units.literal: Chu people took Xingyang, did not firmly defend Aocang, then withdrew and went east, ordered suitable troops divide defend Chenggao, this is heaven's means to assist Han.

units.zh: 方今楚易取而漢反卻，自奪其便，臣竊以為過矣。
units.en: Now, Chu is easy to take, yet Han instead retreats, depriving itself of this advantage. I secretly believe this is a mistake.
units.literal: Now Chu easy to take yet Han instead retreats, self-deprives its advantage, I secretly think it is a mistake.

units.zh: 且兩雄不俱立，楚漢久相持不決，百姓騷動，海內搖蕩，農夫釋耒，工女下機，天下之心未有所定也。
units.en: Moreover, two heroes cannot stand together. Chu and Han have long contended without resolution, the common people are agitated, the realm is shaken, farmers have abandoned their plows, and weaving women have left their looms. The hearts of the people are not yet settled.
units.literal: Moreover, two heroes cannot stand together, Chu Han long mutually contend undecided, common people agitated, within seas shaken, farmers abandon plows, weaving women leave looms, all under heaven's heart not yet settled.

units.zh: 願足下急復進兵，收取滎陽，據敖倉之粟，塞成皋之險，杜大行之道，距蜚狐之口，守白馬之津，以示諸侯效實形制之勢，則天下知所歸矣。
units.en: I wish your excellency to urgently advance troops again, take Xingyang, occupy Aocang's grain, block Chenggao's defiles, cut off the road through Taihang, hold the mouth of Feihu, and guard Baima's ford. Show the feudal lords the force of real control, and then the whole realm will know where to turn.
units.literal: Wish your excellency urgently again advance troops, receive Xingyang, occupy Aocang's grain, block Chenggao's defiles, dam Daxing's road, distance Feihu's mouth, guard Baima's ford, to show feudal lords imitate reality form control power, then all under heaven know where to return.

units.zh: 方今燕、趙已定，唯齊未下。
units.en: Now, Yan and Zhao are already settled; only Qi has not yet submitted.
units.literal: Now Yan, Zhao already settled, only Qi not yet submitted.

units.zh: 今田廣據千里之齊，田閒將二十萬之眾，軍於歷城，諸田宗彊，負海阻河濟，南近楚，人多變詐，足下雖遣數十萬師，未可以歲月破也。
units.en: Now, Tian Guang occupies a thousand li of Qi, and Tian Jian leads an army of two hundred thousand, encamped at Licheng. The Tian clans are strong, relying on the sea and shielded by the Yellow and Ji Rivers. To the south, they are close to Chu, and their people are often deceitful. Even if your excellency sends hundreds of thousands of troops, you cannot break them in months or years.
units.literal: Now Tian Guang occupies thousand li of Qi, Tian Jian leads two hundred thousand troops, encamped at Licheng, various Tian clans strong, relying on sea obstructed by Yellow River Ji River, south near Chu, people many deceitful, your excellency even if sends hundreds of thousands troops, cannot in months years break it.

units.zh: 臣請得奉明詔說齊王，使為漢而稱東藩。」
units.en: I request to be allowed to respectfully carry out a clear edict to persuade the King of Qi, to make him serve Han and be called an eastern vassal.'
units.literal: I request to be allowed respectfully carry out clear edict persuade Qi king, make him serve Han and be called eastern vassal.'

units.zh: 上曰：「善。」
units.en: The Emperor said: 'Good.'
units.literal: The Sovereign said: 'Good.'

units.zh: 乃從其畫，復守敖倉，而使酈生說齊王曰：「王知天下之所歸乎？」
units.en: Then, following his plan, Liu Bang again defended Aocang and sent Li Sheng to persuade the King of Qi, saying: 'Does the King know where the realm is turning?'
units.literal: Then followed his plan, again defended Aocang, and sent Li Sheng persuade Qi king said: 'Does the king know where all under heaven returns?'

units.zh: 王曰：「不知也。」
units.en: The King replied: 'I do not know.'
units.literal: King said: 'Do not know.'

units.zh: 曰：「王知天下之所歸，則齊國可得而有也；
units.en: Li Sheng said: 'If the King knows where the realm is turning, then the state of Qi can be taken and held;
units.literal: Li Yiji said: 'If the King knows where all under heaven is turning, then the state of Qi can be obtained and possessed;

units.zh: 若不知天下之所歸，即齊國未可得保也。」
units.en: if you do not know where the realm is turning, then the state of Qi cannot be preserved.'
units.literal: if does not know where all under heaven returns, then Qi state cannot be preserved.'

units.zh: 齊王曰：「天下何所歸？」
units.en: The King of Qi asked: 'Where is the realm turning?'
units.literal: Qi king said: 'Where does all under heaven return?'

units.zh: 曰：「歸漢。」
units.en: Li Sheng replied: 'Submit to Han.'
units.literal: Li Yiji replied: 'Submit to Han.'

units.zh: 曰：「先生何以言之？」
units.en: The king asked, 'On what grounds do you say this, sir?'
units.literal: The King asked: 'Sir, why do you speak thus?'

units.zh: 曰：「漢王與項王力西面擊秦，約先入咸陽者王之。
units.en: Li Sheng explained: 'The Han King and Xiang Yu jointly attacked Qin from the west, agreeing that whoever entered Xianyang first would become king.
units.literal: Li Yiji said: 'The King of Han and Xiang Yu jointly attacked Qin from the west, agreeing that whoever entered Xianyang first would become king.

units.zh: 漢王先入咸陽，項王負約不與而王之漢中。
units.en: The King of Han was the first to enter Xianyang, but the King of Xiang broke the covenant and, instead of granting him that kingship, made him king of Hanzhong.
units.literal: The Han King entered Xianyang first, but Xiang Yu broke the agreement and did not grant him the kingship, instead enfeoffing him in Hanzhong.

units.zh: 項王遷殺義帝，漢王聞之，起蜀漢之兵擊三秦，出關而責義帝之處，收天下之兵，立諸侯之後。
units.en: Xiang Yu relocated and assassinated the Righteous Emperor. When the Han King heard of this, he raised troops from Shu and Han to attack the Three Qins, emerged from the pass to demand justice for the Righteous Emperor's death, gathered armies from all quarters, and restored the descendants of the feudal lords to their positions.
units.literal: Xiang Yu moved and killed Righteous Emperor, Han King heard it, raised Shu-Han troops to attack San Qin, came out of pass and demanded Righteous Emperor's place, gathered all-under-heaven's troops, established feudal lords' descendants.

units.zh: 降城即以侯其將，得賂即以分其士，與天下同其利，豪英賢才皆樂為之用。
units.en: When a city surrendered, he immediately enfeoffed its commanders as marquises. When he seized spoils, he shared them at once with his soldiers. He shared the empire's benefits broadly, and so the brave, the talented, and the worthy all gladly served him.
units.literal: When cities surrendered, he immediately enfeoffed their generals as marquises. When he obtained booty, he immediately shared it with his soldiers. He shared benefits equally with all under heaven, so that heroic elites and worthy talents were all glad to serve him.

units.zh: 諸侯之兵四面而至，蜀漢之粟方船而下。
units.en: The troops of the feudal lords arrived from all four directions, while grain from Shu and Han was transported downriver in large square boats.
units.literal: Feudal lords' troops arrived from four directions, Shu-Han grain came down in square boats.

units.zh: 項王有倍約之名，殺義帝之負；
units.en: Xiang Yu bore the reputation of breaking agreements and the burden of assassinating the Righteous Emperor;
units.literal: Xiang Yu had name of breaking agreements, burden of killing Righteous Emperor;

units.zh: 於人之功無所記，於人之罪無所忘；
units.en: he remembered no one's merits but forgot no one's faults;
units.literal: regarding people's merits remembered nothing, regarding people's faults forgot nothing;

units.zh: 戰勝而不得其賞，拔城而不得其封；
units.en: those who won battles received no rewards, those who captured cities received no enfeoffments;
units.literal: won battles but received no rewards, captured cities but received no enfeoffments;

units.zh: 非項氏莫得用事；
units.en: only members of the Xiang clan could hold positions of authority;
units.literal: only Xiang clan could hold office;

units.zh: 為人刻印，刓而不能授；
units.en: he had seals carved for people but kept them blunted and would not grant them;
units.literal: carved seals for people, blunted them and could not grant;

units.zh: 攻城得賂，積而不能賞：天下畔之，賢才怨之，而莫為之用。
units.en: when he captured cities and obtained booty, he hoarded it without distributing rewards. All under heaven rebelled against him, worthy talents resented him, and no one would serve him.
units.literal: attacked cities obtained booty, accumulated it and could not reward: all-under-heaven rebelled against him, worthy talents resented him, and none would serve him.

units.zh: 故天下之士歸於漢王，可坐而策也。
units.en: Therefore, all the scholars under heaven have turned to the Han King. Victory can be achieved without leaving one's seat.
units.literal: Therefore, all-under-heaven's scholars returned to Han King, can be determined while seated.

units.zh: 夫漢王發蜀漢，定三秦；
units.en: Now the Han King marched forth from Shu and Han and pacified the Three Qins;
units.literal: Now Han King issued from Shu-Han, pacified San Qin;

units.zh: 涉西河之外，援上黨之兵；
units.en: he crossed beyond the Xi River and drew in troops from Shangdang;
units.literal: crossed beyond Xi River, drew Shangdang's troops;

units.zh: 下井陘，誅成安君；
units.en: he descended through the Jingxing Pass and executed Lord Cheng'an;
units.literal: descended Jingxing, executed Cheng An Jun;

units.zh: 破北魏，舉三十二城：此蚩尤之兵也，非人之力也，天之福也。
units.en: he defeated the Wei of the north and captured thirty-two cities. This was the army of Chiyou, not achieved through human effort but through heaven's blessing.
units.literal: defeated Northern Wei, raised thirty-two cities: this was Chiyou's army, not human strength, heaven's blessing.

units.zh: 今已據敖倉之粟，塞成皋之險，守白馬之津，杜大行之阪，距蜚狐之口，天下後服者先亡矣。
units.en: Now he has already seized the grain stores of Aocang, blocked the strategic passes at Chenggao, guards the ford at Baima, blocked the Taihang slopes, and confronts Feihu Pass. Those under heaven who submit late will perish first.
units.literal: Now already occupied Aocang's grain, blocked Chenggao's defiles, guarded Baima's ford, blocked Taihang's slopes, confronted Feihu's mouth, all-under-heaven late submitters first perish.

units.zh: 王疾先下漢王，齊國社稷可得而保也；
units.en: Your Majesty, hasten to submit first to the Han King, and the altars of soil and grain of the state of Qi can be preserved;
units.literal: King quickly first submit to Han King, Qi state's altars of soil and grain can be preserved;

units.zh: 不下漢王，危亡可立而待也。」
units.en: If you do not submit to the King of Han, ruin and destruction will come upon you before you can draw another breath.'
units.literal: if you do not submit to the Han King, peril and extinction await you immediately.'

units.zh: 田廣以為然，乃聽酈生，罷歷下兵守戰備，與酈生日縱酒。
units.en: Tian Guang found this persuasive. He heeded Li Yiji, stood down the garrison at Lixia and disbanded his war preparations, and spent his days drinking freely with Li Yiji.
units.literal: Tian Guang considered this correct, so he heeded Li Sheng, dismissed the troops guarding Lixia and their battle preparations, and indulged daily in drinking with Li Sheng.

units.zh: 淮陰侯聞酈生伏軾下齊七十餘城，乃夜度兵平原襲齊。
units.en: When the Marquis of Huaiyin heard that Li Yiji had, merely by leaning on the crossbar of his carriage and speaking, won over more than seventy cities of Qi, he crossed his forces at Pingyuan by night and launched a surprise attack on Qi.
units.literal: When the Marquis of Huaiyin heard that Li Sheng had leaned on his carriage crossbar and brought Qi seventy-odd cities to submission, he crossed his troops at Pingyuan by night and attacked Qi.

units.zh: 齊王田廣聞漢兵至，以為酈生賣己，乃曰：「汝能止漢軍，我活汝；
units.en: When King Tian Guang of Qi heard the Han troops had arrived, he thought Li Sheng had betrayed him, and said: 'If you can stop the Han army, I will spare your life;
units.literal: Qi King Tian Guang heard Han troops arrived, thought Li Sheng sold him, then said: 'You can stop Han army, I spare your life;

units.zh: 不然，我將亨汝！」
units.en: otherwise, I will have you boiled alive!'
units.literal: otherwise, I will boil you!'

units.zh: 酈生曰：「舉大事不細謹，盛德不辭讓。
units.en: Li Yiji replied: 'In undertaking great affairs one cannot fuss over petty details; in abundant virtue one does not decline what is due.
units.literal: Li Yiji said: 'In undertaking great affairs one cannot be meticulous in small matters; in abundant virtue one does not decline what is fitting.

units.zh: 而公不為若更言！」
units.en: Yet you will not plead for me to him again!'
units.literal: Yet you will not speak to him on my behalf again!'

units.zh: 齊王遂亨酈生，引兵東走。
units.en: The King of Qi had Li Yiji boiled alive, then led his troops in flight to the east.
units.literal: The Qi King then had Li Sheng boiled alive and led his troops in flight eastward.

units.zh: 漢十二年，曲周侯酈商以丞相將兵擊黥布有功。
units.en: In the twelfth year of Han, the Marquis of Quzhou, Li Shang, led troops as chancellor to attack Qing Bu and distinguished himself in the campaign.
units.literal: In the twelfth year of Han, the Marquis of Quzhou, Li Shang, served as chancellor and led troops to attack Qing Bu, achieving merit.

units.zh: 高祖舉列侯功臣，思酈食其。
units.en: When Gaozu reviewed the marquises and their merits, he was reminded of Li Yiji.
units.literal: When Gaozu evaluated the marquises and meritorious ministers, he thought of Li Yiji.

units.zh: 酈食其子疥數將兵，功未當侯，上以其父故，封疥為高梁侯。
units.en: Li Yiji's son Jie had led troops on several occasions, but his merit was not yet worthy of a marquisate. The emperor, because of his father's sake, enfeoffed Jie as the Marquis of Gaoliang.
units.literal: Li Yiji's son Jie several times led troops, merit not yet worthy of marquisate, Sovereign because of his father reason, enfeoffed Jie as Gaoliang Hou.

units.zh: 後更食武遂，嗣三世。
units.en: Later the fief was changed to Wusui, and the title passed through three generations.
units.literal: Later he was given Wusui as his fief, and the title was inherited for three generations.

units.zh: 元狩元年中，武遂侯平坐詐詔衡山王取百斤金，當棄市，病死，國除也。
units.en: In the first year of the Yuanshou era, the Marquis of Wusui, Ping, was convicted of forging an imperial edict to extort a hundred catties of gold from the King of Hengshan. He was sentenced to public execution but died of illness first, and his fief was abolished.
units.literal: In the middle of the first year of Yuanshou, the Marquis of Wusui, Ping, was implicated in forging an edict to extort a hundred jin of gold from the King of Hengshan. He was sentenced to execution in the marketplace, but died of illness, and his fief was abolished.

units.zh: 陸賈者，楚人也。
units.en: Lu Jia was a man of Chu.
units.literal: Lu Jia was from Chu.

units.zh: 以客從高祖定天下，名為有口辯士，居左右，常使諸侯。
units.en: As a retainer, he followed Gaozu in the conquest of the empire. Renowned as an eloquent debater, he remained at the emperor's side and was frequently dispatched on embassies to the feudal lords.
units.literal: As a guest follower, he accompanied Gaozu in pacifying the empire. He was known for his eloquence and stayed close to the emperor, often being sent on missions to the feudal lords.

units.zh: 及高祖時，中國初定，尉他平南越，因王之。
units.en: In the time of Gaozu, when the Central Kingdoms had just been pacified, Zhao Tuo had subdued Nanyue and thereupon made himself its king.
units.literal: When Gaozu was emperor and the central states had just been pacified, Wei Tuo pacified Nanyue and thereupon made himself king.

units.zh: 高祖使陸賈賜尉他印為南越王。
units.en: Gaozu sent Lu Jia to bestow on Zhao Tuo the seal appointing him King of Nanyue.
units.literal: Gaozu sent Lu Jia to bestow upon Wei Tuo the seal making him King of Nanyue.

units.zh: 陸生至，尉他魋結箕倨見陸生。
units.en: When Lu Jia arrived, Zhao Tuo received him with his hair in a barbarian knot, sitting with his legs splayed wide.
units.literal: When Lu Jia arrived, Wei Tuo received him with hair in a mallet-shaped knot, sitting sprawled with legs splayed.

units.zh: 陸生因進說他曰：「足下中國人，親戚昆弟墳在真定。
units.en: Lu Jia then advanced and said in persuasion: 'Your Excellency is a man of the central states, with relatives and brothers whose tombs are in Zhending.
units.literal: Lu Sheng therefore advanced persuaded him said: 'Your Excellency central states person, relatives elder-younger brothers tombs in Zhending.

units.zh: 今足下反天性，棄冠帶，欲以區區之越與天子抗衡為敵國，禍且及身矣。
units.en: Now you have turned against your own nature, cast off the cap and sash of civilization, and seek to pit this insignificant Yue against the Son of Heaven as a rival state. Calamity will soon fall upon you.
units.literal: Now Your Excellency opposes your heavenly nature, abandons civilized dress, and desires to use this meager Yue to contend equally with the Son of Heaven as an enemy state. Calamity will soon befall you.

units.zh: 且夫秦失其政，諸侯豪桀并起，唯漢王先入關，據咸陽。
units.en: When Qin lost its mandate to govern, the heroes among the feudal lords all rose together. Only the King of Han entered the passes first and seized Xianyang.
units.literal: Moreover, when Qin lost its governance, the heroic stalwarts among the feudal lords rose together. Only the Han King first entered the pass and occupied Xianyang.

units.zh: 項羽倍約，自立為西楚霸王，諸侯皆屬，可謂至彊。
units.en: Xiang Yu broke the covenant and proclaimed himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu. All the feudal lords submitted to him, and he could truly be called supreme in power.
units.literal: Xiang Yu broke the agreement and established himself as Hegemon-King of Western Chu. All the feudal lords submitted to him; he could be called supremely powerful.

units.zh: 然漢王起巴蜀，鞭笞天下，劫略諸侯，遂誅項羽滅之。
units.en: Yet the King of Han rose from Ba and Shu, scourged the realm, subdued the feudal lords one by one, and finally destroyed Xiang Yu and extinguished his line.
units.literal: Yet the Han King arose from Bashu, lashed all under heaven, coerced and plundered the feudal lords, and finally executed Xiang Yu and extinguished Chu.

units.zh: 五年之閒，海內平定，此非人力，天之所建也。
units.en: Within five years, all within the seas was pacified. This was not achieved through human effort, but established by heaven.
units.literal: Five years interval, within seas pacified, this not human strength, heaven's establishment.

units.zh: 天子聞君王王南越，不助天下誅暴逆，將相欲移兵而誅王，天子憐百姓新勞苦，故且休之，遣臣授君王印，剖符通使。
units.en: The Son of Heaven heard that you rule over Nanyue yet did not aid in the punishment of the violent and the rebellious. His generals and ministers wished to march their armies south to destroy you, but the Son of Heaven took pity on the common people, who had only just endured such suffering, and so granted you a reprieve. He has sent me to bestow upon you the royal seal and the split tallies for the exchange of envoys.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven heard that Your Lordship rules Nanyue but did not assist in executing the violent and rebellious under heaven. The generals and ministers wished to move troops to execute you, but the Son of Heaven pitied the people who had just suffered hardship, so he temporarily spared you and sent me to bestow upon Your Lordship the seal and split tally for diplomatic relations.

units.zh: 君王宜郊迎，北面稱臣，乃欲以新造未集之越，屈彊於此。
units.en: You should go out beyond the walls to welcome the envoy, face north and declare yourself a vassal. Instead, you seek to defy the empire with this newly founded and still unsteady Yue.
units.literal: Your Lordship should welcome the envoy in the suburbs, face north and declare yourself a minister. Yet you desire to use this newly established and not yet unified Yue to contend with strength here.

units.zh: 漢誠聞之，掘燒王先人冢，夷滅宗族，使一偏將將十萬眾臨越，則越殺王降漢，如反覆手耳。」
units.en: If Han truly hears of this, they will dig up and burn your ancestors' tombs, raze and extinguish your clan and family, send a single general with a hundred thousand troops to confront Yue, and then Yue will kill you and submit to Han—as easy as turning over one's hand.'
units.literal: Han truly hears it, dig burn king ancestors tombs, raze extinguish clan family, send one partial general lead hundred thousand multitude confront Yue, then Yue kill king submit Han, like turn over hand only.'

units.zh: 於是尉他乃蹶然起坐，謝陸生曰：「居蠻夷中久，殊失禮義。」
units.en: At this, Wei Tuo suddenly rose to his feet and apologized to Lu Jia, saying: 'Having dwelt among barbarians for so long, I have greatly lost the rites and righteousness.'
units.literal: Thereupon Wei Tuo then suddenly rose sat, apologized Lu Sheng said: 'Dwelt among barbarians long, greatly lost rites righteousness.'

units.zh: 因問陸生曰：「我孰與蕭何、曹參、韓信賢？」
units.en: He then asked Lu Jia: 'Compared to Xiao He, Cao Shen, and Han Xin, who am I most like in worthiness?'
units.literal: Therefore, asked Lu Sheng said: 'I compared with Xiao He, Cao Shen, Han Xin who worthy?'

units.zh: 陸生曰：「王似賢。」
units.en: Lu Jia replied: 'Your Majesty seems the worthier.'
units.literal: Lu Sheng said: 'King resembles worthy.'

units.zh: 復曰：「我孰與皇帝賢？」
units.en: He asked again: 'Compared to the Emperor, who am I most like in worthiness?'
units.literal: Again said: 'I compared with Emperor who worthy?'

units.zh: 陸生曰：「皇帝起豐沛，討暴秦，誅彊楚，為天下興利除害，繼五帝三王之業，統理中國。
units.en: Lu Jia replied: 'The Emperor arose from Feng and Pei, attacked the violent Qin, executed the strong Chu, brought benefits and removed harms for the realm, succeeded the enterprises of the Five Emperors and Three Kings, and unified governance of the central states.
units.literal: Lu Sheng said: 'Emperor arose Fengpei, attacked violent Qin, executed strong Chu, for all-under-heaven raised benefit eliminated harm, succeeded Five Emperors Three Kings' enterprise, unified governed central states.

units.zh: 中國之人以億計，地方萬里，居天下之膏腴，人眾車轝，萬物殷富，政由一家，自天地剖泮未始有也。
units.en: The people of the central states number in the hundreds of millions, the territory spans ten thousand li, occupying the fertile lands under heaven. The people are numerous and carriages many, all things abundantly rich. Governance is by one family—such a thing has never existed since heaven and earth were separated.
units.literal: central states' people counted in hundreds of millions, territory ten thousand li, occupies all-under-heaven's fertile lands, people numerous carriages many, myriad things abundantly rich, governance by one family, since heaven earth separated never begun have also.

units.zh: 今王眾不過數十萬，皆蠻夷，崎嶇山海閒，譬若漢一郡，王何乃比於漢！」
units.en: Now Your Majesty's forces do not exceed several tens of thousands, all of them barbarian peoples, situated in rugged terrain between mountains and seas—like a single commandery of Han. Why then does Your Majesty compare yourself to Han!'
units.literal: Now king's multitudes not exceeding several tens of thousands, all barbarians foreigners, rugged mountains seas between, like Han one commandery, king why then compare to Han!'

units.zh: 尉他大笑曰：「吾不起中國，故王此。
units.en: Wei Tuo laughed heartily and said: 'I did not arise in the central states, and so I am king here.
units.literal: Wei Tuo greatly laughed said: 'I not arise central states, therefore king this.

units.zh: 使我居中國，何渠不若漢？」
units.en: If I had been placed in the central states, why would I be any less than Han?'
units.literal: If made me dwell central states, why not like Han?'

units.zh: 乃大說陸生，留與飲數月。
units.en: He was greatly delighted with Lu Jia and kept him as a guest, drinking together for many months.
units.literal: He was greatly pleased with Lu Jia and kept him there drinking for several months.

units.zh: 曰：「越中無足與語，至生來，令我日聞所不聞。」
units.en: Zhao Tuo said: 'In all of Yue there was no one worthy of conversation; since you came, I hear daily what I have never heard before.'
units.literal: Zhao Tuo said: 'In all of Yue there is no one worthy of conversation; since you came, I hear daily what I have never heard before.'

units.zh: 賜陸生橐中裝直千金，他送亦千金。
units.en: He presented Lu Jia with baggage worth a thousand gold pieces, and gave him an additional thousand in gold as a parting gift.
units.literal: He bestowed upon Lu Jia valuables in bags worth a thousand gold pieces, and when Lu Jia departed, he gave him another thousand gold pieces as a send-off gift.

units.zh: 陸生卒拜尉他為南越王，令稱臣奉漢約。
units.en: Lu Jia thus succeeded in installing Zhao Tuo as King of Nanyue and securing his pledge to serve as a vassal and uphold the covenant with Han.
units.literal: Lu Jia finally bowed Wei Tuo as King of Nanyue and had him declare himself a minister and uphold the covenant with Han.

units.zh: 歸報，高祖大悅，拜賈為太中大夫。
units.en: When he returned and reported his success, Gaozu was greatly pleased and appointed Lu Jia as Grand Palace Grandee.
units.literal: When he returned and reported, Gaozu was greatly pleased and appointed Jia as Grand Palace Grandee.

units.zh: 陸生時時前說稱詩書。
units.en: Lu Jia would often come forward and speak at court, citing the Book of Odes and the Book of Documents.
units.literal: Lu Jia would often advance and speak, praising the Poetry and Documents.

units.zh: 高帝罵之曰：「乃公居馬上而得之，安事詩書！」
units.en: Emperor Gao cursed him, saying, 'Your lord and master won the empire on horseback. What use do I have for the Odes and Documents!'
units.literal: The Gao Emperor cursed him and said: 'I, your old man, obtained the empire on horseback—what need have I for the Poetry and Documents!'

units.zh: 陸生曰；
units.en: Lu Jia replied:
units.literal: Lu Jia said:

units.zh: 「居馬上得之，寧可以馬上治之乎？
units.en: 'You obtained it while dwelling on horseback—can it be governed while on horseback?
units.literal: 'Dwelt on horseback obtained it, how can on horseback govern it?

units.zh: 且湯武逆取而以順守之，文武并用，長久之術也。
units.en: Moreover, Tang and Wu seized power through rebellion but governed through righteousness. Employing both the civil and the martial arts together is the method for enduring rule.
units.literal: Moreover, Tang and Wu took it rebelliously but guarded it properly. Using both civil and martial means together is the method for long-lasting rule.

units.zh: 昔者吳王夫差、智伯極武而亡；
units.en: Formerly, King Fucha of Wu and Zhi Bo perished by relying solely on martial force;
units.literal: Formerly Wu King Fucha, Zhi Bo extreme martial perished;

units.zh: 秦任刑法不變，卒滅趙氏。
units.en: Qin relied on punishments and legalism without change, and in the end the house of Qin was destroyed.
units.literal: Qin employed punishments and laws without change, and finally extinguished the Zhao clan.

units.zh: 鄉使秦已并天下，行仁義，法先聖，陛下安得而有之？」
units.en: Suppose Qin had already unified the empire, practiced benevolence and righteousness, and modeled itself on the former sages—how would Your Majesty have obtained it?'
units.literal: Suppose made Qin already united all-under-heaven, practiced benevolence righteousness, modeled former sages, Your Majesty how obtained have it?'

units.zh: 高帝不懌而有慚色，乃謂陸生曰：「試為我著秦所以失天下，吾所以得之者何，及古成敗之國。」
units.en: The Gao Emperor was displeased and showed an ashamed expression, then said to Lu Jia: 'Try writing for me why Qin lost the empire, how I obtained it, and examples of ancient states that succeeded or failed.'
units.literal: Gao Emperor displeased had ashamed color, then told Lu Sheng said: 'Try for me write Qin why lost all-under-heaven, I why obtained it what, and ancient success failure states.'

units.zh: 陸生乃粗述存亡之徵，凡著十二篇。
units.en: Lu Jia then outlined the signs that determine the survival and ruin of states, producing twelve chapters in all.
units.literal: Lu Jia then roughly described the omens of survival and extinction, altogether writing twelve chapters.

units.zh: 每奏一篇，高帝未嘗不稱善，左右呼萬歲，號其書曰「新語」。
units.en: Each time he presented a chapter, the Gao Emperor never failed to call it good, and the attendants cried 'Ten thousand years!' They titled his book 'New Sayings'.
units.literal: Each presented one chapter, Gao Emperor never not called good, attendants cried ten thousand years, titled his book 'New Sayings'.

units.zh: 孝惠帝時，呂太后用事，欲王諸呂，畏大臣有口者，陸生自度不能爭之，乃病免家居。
units.en: During the Xiaohui Emperor's time, the Lü Empress Dowager handled affairs and wanted to enfeoff the Lü clansmen as kings. She feared eloquent ministers, so Lu Jia, judging that he could not contend against it, feigned illness and resigned to return home.
units.literal: Xiaohui Emperor time, Lü Empress Dowager handled affairs, desired king various Lü, feared ministers eloquent ones, Lu Sheng self measured could not contend it, then illness resigned returned home.

units.zh: 以好畤田地善，可以家焉。
units.en: Since the land at Haozhi was fertile, he made his home there.
units.literal: Because the fields and lands in Haozhi were good, he could establish his household there.

units.zh: 有五男，乃出所使越得橐中裝賣千金，分其子，子二百金，令為生產。
units.en: He had five sons. He brought out the gifts he had received on his mission to Yue, sold them for a thousand gold pieces, and divided the sum equally among his sons, two hundred gold apiece, ordering them to invest and make a living.
units.literal: He had five sons, so he brought out the valuables in bags that he had obtained from his mission to Yue, which sold for a thousand gold pieces. He divided them among his sons, giving each son two hundred gold pieces, and ordered them to engage in business.

units.zh: 陸生常安車駟馬，從歌舞鼓琴瑟侍者十人，寶劍直百金，謂其子曰：「與汝約：過汝，汝給吾人馬酒食，極欲，十日而更。
units.en: Lu Jia often rode in an easy carriage drawn by four horses, followed by ten attendants who sang, danced, and played qin and se. His precious sword was worth a hundred gold pieces. He told his sons: 'I make this agreement with you: when I visit you, you must provide my men, horses, wine, and food, indulging my every desire. Then after ten days I will change to another son's home.
units.literal: Lu Sheng often easy carriage four horses, followed song dance drummed qin se attendants ten persons, precious sword worth hundred gold, told his sons said: 'With you agreement: visit you, you provide my men horses wine food, extreme desires, ten days then change.

units.zh: 所死家，得寶劍車騎侍從者。
units.en: Whichever household I happen to die in shall keep the precious sword, the carriage, the horses, and the attendants.
units.literal: When I die, the household where I am staying will obtain the precious sword, carriage, cavalry, and attendants.

units.zh: 一歲中往來過他客，率不過再三過，數見不鮮，無久慁公為也。」
units.en: In the course of a year, when I come and go visiting other guests, I generally won't exceed two or three visits. Frequent seeing becomes stale, so I won't tire you for long.'
units.literal: One year middle come go visit other guests, rate not exceed two three visits, frequent seeing not fresh, no long tire you for also.'

units.zh: 呂太后時，王諸呂，諸呂擅權，欲劫少主，危劉氏。
units.en: During the Lü Empress Dowager's time, she enfeoffed the Lü clansmen as kings. The Lü clansmen usurped power and sought to coerce the young ruler and endanger the Liu clan.
units.literal: Lü Empress Dowager time, enfeoffed various Lü, various Lü usurped power, desired coerce young ruler, endangered Liu clan.

units.zh: 右丞相陳平患之，力不能爭，恐禍及己，常燕居深念。
units.en: The Right Chancellor, Chen Ping, was deeply troubled by this. He lacked the power to oppose it openly and feared the disaster would engulf him, so he often withdrew into solitude and brooded.
units.literal: The Right Chancellor Chen Ping was worried about this. He lacked the strength to contend against it and feared calamity would befall him, so he often secluded himself in deep contemplation.

units.zh: 陸生往請，直入坐，而陳丞相方深念，不時見陸生。
units.en: Lu Jia went to call on him, walked straight in and sat down. But Chancellor Chen was lost in thought and did not notice Lu Jia at first.
units.literal: Lu Jia went to request an audience and directly entered and sat down. But the Chancellor Chen was just deeply pondering and did not immediately notice Lu Jia.

units.zh: 陸生曰：「何念之深也？」
units.en: Lu Jia said: 'What are you pondering so deeply?'
units.literal: Lu Sheng said: 'What pondering so deep?'

units.zh: 陳平曰：「生揣我何念？」
units.en: Chen Ping said: 'Guess what I am pondering?'
units.literal: Chen Ping said: 'Sheng guess I what ponder?'

units.zh: 陸生曰：「足下位為上相，食三萬戶侯，可謂極富貴無欲矣。
units.en: Lu Jia said: 'Your Excellency holds the position of chief chancellor and receives the income from a marquisate of thirty thousand households. You can be said to have reached the extreme of riches and nobility with no further desires.
units.literal: Lu Sheng said: 'Your Excellency position chief chancellor, ate thirty thousand households marquisate, can be called extreme riches nobility no desires.

units.zh: 然有憂念，不過患諸呂、少主耳。」
units.en: Yet you have worries on your mind, which can only be concern for the Lü clansmen and the young ruler.'
units.literal: Yet have worry thought, no more than troubled various Lü, young ruler.'

units.zh: 陳平曰：「然。
units.en: Chen Ping said: 'Correct.
units.literal: Chen Ping said: 'Correct.

units.zh: 為之柰何？」
units.en: What can be done about it?'
units.literal: 'What can be done about it?'

units.zh: 陸生曰：「天下安，注意相；
units.en: Lu Jia said: 'When the empire is peaceful, pay attention to the chancellor;
units.literal: Lu Sheng said: 'All-under-heaven peaceful, pay attention chancellor;

units.zh: 天下危，注意將。
units.en: When the empire is in peril, all eyes turn to the generals.
units.literal: when the empire is in danger, pay attention to the general.

units.zh: 將相和調，則士務附；
units.en: When generals and chancellors are harmonious and coordinated, then the scholars will diligently attach themselves;
units.literal: General chancellor harmonious coordinated, then scholars diligently attached;

units.zh: 士務附，天下雖有變，即權不分。
units.en: If the scholars rally to your side, then even should the empire be convulsed, power will not be divided.
units.literal: when scholars diligently attach themselves, even if the empire has changes, authority will not be divided.

units.zh: 為社稷計，在兩君掌握耳。
units.en: The fate of the altars of state rests in the hands of you two lords alone.
units.literal: For the sake of the altars of soil and grain, it rests in the grasp of you two lords.

units.zh: 臣常欲謂太尉絳侯，絳侯與我戲，易吾言。
units.en: I have long wished to speak of this to the Grand Commandant, the Marquis of Jiang, but the Marquis treats me as a jest and makes light of my words.
units.literal: I have often desired to tell the Grand Commandant, the Marquis of Jiang, but the Marquis of Jiang joked with me and dismissed my words.

units.zh: 君何不交驩太尉，深相結？」
units.en: Why don't you befriend the Grand Commandant and form deep ties with him?'
units.literal: You why not befriend Grand Commandant, deeply mutually bind?'

units.zh: 為陳平畫呂氏數事。
units.en: He planned several matters concerning the Lü clan for Chen Ping.
units.literal: For Chen Ping planned Lü clan several matters.

units.zh: 陳平用其計，乃以五百金為絳侯壽，厚具樂飲；
units.en: Chen Ping used his plan, so he presented five hundred gold pieces as a birthday gift to the Marquis of Jiang, and prepared abundant music and drinking;
units.literal: Chen Ping used his plan, then with five hundred gold for Jiang Hou birthday, abundantly prepared music drinking;

units.zh: 太尉亦報如之。
units.en: The Grand Commandant reciprocated in kind.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant also repaid him in like manner.

units.zh: 此兩人深相結，則呂氏謀益衰。
units.en: When these two men formed deep ties, the Lü clan's plots increasingly declined.
units.literal: These two men deeply mutually bound, then Lü clan plots increasingly declined.

units.zh: 陳平乃以奴婢百人，車馬五十乘，錢五百萬，遺陸生為飲食費。
units.en: Chen Ping then presented Lu Jia with a hundred servants, fifty teams of carriages and horses, and five million cash to cover his expenses for entertaining.
units.literal: Chen Ping then bestowed upon Lu Jia a hundred male and female slaves, fifty teams of carriages and horses, and five million cash for his food and drink expenses.

units.zh: 陸生以此游漢廷公卿閒，名聲藉甚。
units.en: With these resources, Lu Jia moved freely among the dukes and ministers of the Han court, and his reputation grew enormously.
units.literal: With this, Lu Jia wandered among the dukes and ministers of the Han court, and his reputation became exceedingly great.

units.zh: 及誅諸呂，立孝文帝，陸生頗有力焉。
units.en: When the Lü clansmen were executed and Emperor Wen was enthroned, Lu Jia played a considerable part.
units.literal: When the various Lü were executed and Emperor Xiaowen was enthroned, Lu Jia played a considerable part.

units.zh: 孝文帝即位，欲使人之南越。
units.en: When Emperor Wen ascended the throne, he wished to send an envoy to Nanyue.
units.literal: When the Xiaowen Emperor ascended the throne, he desired to send someone to Nanyue.

units.zh: 陳丞相等乃言陸生為太中大夫，往使尉他，令尉他去黃屋稱制，令比諸侯，皆如意旨。
units.en: Chancellor Chen and others recommended that Lu Jia be appointed Grand Palace Grandee and sent as envoy to Zhao Tuo, to order him to remove the imperial yellow canopy and cease issuing edicts, and to conduct himself as befitted a feudal lord. All was carried out according to the emperor's wishes.
units.literal: The Chancellor Chen and others then recommended that Lu Jia be made Grand Palace Grandee and sent to dispatch Wei Tuo, ordering him to remove the yellow canopy and cease declaring decrees, ordering him to be equal to the feudal lords—all according to the emperor's intentions.

units.zh: 語在南越語中。
units.en: The full account may be found in the Biography of Nanyue.
units.literal: The account is in the Nanyue biography.

units.zh: 陸生竟以壽終。
units.en: Lu Jia ultimately died of old age.
units.literal: Lu Jia finally died of old age.

units.zh: 平原君朱建者，楚人也。
units.en: The Lord of Pingyuan, Zhu Jian, was a man of Chu.
units.literal: Lord Pingyuan, Zhu Jian, was from Chu.

units.zh: 故嘗為淮南王黥布相，有罪去，後復事黥布。
units.en: He had once served as chancellor to the King of Huainan, Qing Bu, but left after committing an offense. Later he returned to Qing Bu's service.
units.literal: He had formerly served as chancellor to the King of Huainan, Qing Bu, but left because of a crime. Later he served Qing Bu again.

units.zh: 布欲反時，問平原君，平原君非之，布不聽而聽梁父侯，遂反。
units.en: When Qing Bu contemplated rebellion, he consulted the Lord of Pingyuan, who argued against it. Qing Bu disregarded his counsel and followed the advice of the Marquis of Liangfu instead, and so he rebelled.
units.literal: When Qing Bu desired to rebel, he asked the Lord of Pingyuan, who opposed it. Qing Bu did not listen but listened to the Marquis of Liangfu, and then rebelled.

units.zh: 漢已誅布，聞平原君諫不與謀，得不誅。
units.en: After Han destroyed Qing Bu, it came to light that the Lord of Pingyuan had counseled against the rebellion and had taken no part in the conspiracy, so he was spared.
units.literal: After Han had executed Qing Bu, they heard that the Lord of Pingyuan had admonished against it and was not part of the plot, so he was not executed.

units.zh: 語在黥布語中。
units.en: The full account may be found in the Biography of Qing Bu.
units.literal: The account is in the Qing Bu biography.

units.zh: 平原君為人辯有口，刻廉剛直，家於長安。
units.en: The Lord of Pingyuan was eloquent and articulate, incisive and incorruptible, upright and straightforward. He established his household in Chang'an.
units.literal: Pingyuan Jun as person eloquent had mouth, incisive incorruptible upright straight, established household in Chang'an.

units.zh: 行不茍合，義不取容。
units.en: In his conduct he would not compromise for the sake of convenience; in his principles he would not bend to win approval.
units.literal: In conduct he did not casually unite with others; in righteousness he did not seek accommodation.

units.zh: 辟陽侯行不正，得幸呂太后。
units.en: The Marquis of Biyang conducted himself improperly but obtained the favor of the Lü Empress Dowager.
units.literal: Biyang Hou conduct not correct, obtained favor Lü Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 時辟陽侯欲知平原君，平原君不肯見。
units.en: At that time the Marquis of Biyang wished to befriend the Lord of Pingyuan, but the Lord of Pingyuan refused to receive him.
units.literal: At this time the Marquis of Biyang desired to know the Lord of Pingyuan, but the Lord of Pingyuan was unwilling to see him.

units.zh: 及平原君母死，陸生素與平原君善，過之。
units.en: When the Lord of Pingyuan's mother died, Lu Jia, who had long been on good terms with him, went to pay his respects.
units.literal: When the Lord of Pingyuan's mother died, Lu Jia—who was always on good terms with the Lord of Pingyuan—visited him.

units.zh: 平原君家貧，未有以發喪，方假貸服具，陸生令平原君發喪。
units.en: The Lord of Pingyuan's household was impoverished and lacked the means to hold a proper funeral. He was still borrowing mourning garments and supplies when Lu Jia told him to go ahead and begin the funeral rites.
units.literal: The Lord of Pingyuan's household was poor and did not yet have the means to hold the funeral. He was just borrowing mourning garments, so Lu Jia ordered the Lord of Pingyuan to hold the funeral.

units.zh: 陸生往見辟陽侯，賀曰：「平原君母死。」
units.en: Lu Jia went to see the Marquis of Biyang and congratulated him, saying: 'The Lord of Pingyuan's mother has died.'
units.literal: Lu Sheng went saw Biyang Hou, congratulated said: 'Pingyuan Jun mother died.'

units.zh: 辟陽侯曰：「平原君母死，何乃賀我乎？」
units.en: The Marquis of Biyang said: 'The Lord of Pingyuan's mother has died—why then do you congratulate me?'
units.literal: Biyang Hou said: 'Pingyuan Jun mother died, why then congratulate me?'

units.zh: 陸賈曰：「前日君侯欲知平原君，平原君義不知君，以其母故。
units.en: Lu Jia said: 'Previously Your Lordship desired to know the Lord of Pingyuan, but the Lord of Pingyuan, out of righteousness, did not know Your Lordship because of his mother.
units.literal: Lu Jia said: 'Former days Your Lordship desired know Pingyuan Jun, Pingyuan Jun righteousness not know Your Lordship, because of his mother reason.

units.zh: 今其母死，君誠厚送喪，則彼為君死矣。」
units.en: Now that his mother has died, if Your Lordship truly sends generous funeral gifts, then he will die for Your Lordship.'
units.literal: Now his mother died, Your Lordship truly generously send funeral, then he for Your Lordship die.'

units.zh: 辟陽侯乃奉百金往稅。
units.en: The Marquis of Biyang then presented a hundred gold pieces as a condolence gift.
units.literal: The Marquis of Biyang then offered a hundred gold pieces and went to contribute.

units.zh: 列侯貴人以辟陽侯故，往稅凡五百金。
units.en: Following the Marquis of Biyang's lead, the other marquises and nobles contributed a total of five hundred gold pieces.
units.literal: The marquises and nobles, because of the Marquis of Biyang's example, went and contributed altogether five hundred gold pieces.

units.zh: 辟陽侯幸呂太后，人或毀辟陽侯於孝惠帝，孝惠帝大怒，下吏，欲誅之。
units.en: The Marquis of Biyang was favored by the Lü Empress Dowager. Someone slandered the Marquis of Biyang to the Xiaohui Emperor, who became greatly angered, sent officials, and desired to execute him.
units.literal: Biyang Hou favored Lü Empress Dowager, people or slandered Biyang Hou to Xiaohui Emperor, Xiaohui Emperor greatly angered, sent officials, desired execute him.

units.zh: 呂太后慚，不可以言。
units.en: The Lü Empress Dowager was ashamed and could not speak.
units.literal: Lü Empress Dowager ashamed, not could speak.

units.zh: 大臣多害辟陽侯行，欲遂誅之。
units.en: Many of the senior ministers despised the Marquis of Biyang's behavior and wished to see him put to death.
units.literal: Many of the great ministers hated the Marquis of Biyang's conduct and desired to then execute him.

units.zh: 辟陽侯急，因使人欲見平原君。
units.en: In his desperation, the Marquis of Biyang sent a man to seek an audience with the Lord of Pingyuan.
units.literal: The Marquis of Biyang was urgent, so he sent a person desiring to see the Lord of Pingyuan.

units.zh: 平原君辭曰：「獄急，不敢見君。」
units.en: The Lord of Pingyuan declined, saying: 'The prison matter is urgent—I do not dare see Your Lordship.'
units.literal: Pingyuan Jun declined said: 'Prison urgent, not dare see Your Lordship.'

units.zh: 乃求見孝惠幸臣閎籍孺，說之曰：「君所以得幸帝，天下莫不聞。
units.en: He then sought to see the Xiaohui Emperor's favored minister Hong Jiru and persuaded him, saying: 'That you have obtained the emperor's favor is known throughout the world.
units.literal: Then sought see Xiaohui favored minister Hong Jiru, persuaded him said: 'You because obtained favor emperor, all-under-heaven none not hear.

units.zh: 今辟陽侯幸太后而下吏，道路皆言君讒，欲殺之。
units.en: The Marquis of Biyang is favored by the Empress Dowager, yet he has been handed over to the officials. Everyone on the streets says it was you who slandered him, and that you want him dead.
units.literal: Now the Marquis of Biyang is favored by the empress dowager yet has been sent officials. On the roads all say you slandered him and desired to kill him.

units.zh: 今日辟陽侯誅，旦日太后含怒，亦誅君。
units.en: If the Marquis of Biyang is executed today, tomorrow the Empress Dowager will turn her wrath upon you and have you executed as well.
units.literal: If the Marquis of Biyang is executed today, tomorrow the empress dowager will contain anger and also execute you.

units.zh: 何不肉袒為辟陽侯言於帝？
units.en: Why don't you bare your flesh and speak on behalf of the Marquis of Biyang to the emperor?
units.literal: Why not bare flesh speak for Biyang Hou to emperor?

units.zh: 帝聽君出辟陽侯，太后大驩。
units.en: If the Emperor heeds you and releases the Marquis of Biyang, the Empress Dowager will be overjoyed.
units.literal: If the emperor listens to you and releases the Marquis of Biyang, the empress dowager will be greatly pleased.

units.zh: 兩主共幸君，君貴富益倍矣。」
units.en: The two rulers will together favor you, and your nobility and riches will increase doubly.'
units.literal: Two rulers together favor you, you nobility riches increase double.'

units.zh: 於是閎籍孺大恐，從其計，言帝，果出辟陽侯。
units.en: Hong Jiru was terrified. He followed the plan, spoke to the Emperor, and the Marquis of Biyang was indeed released.
units.literal: Thereupon Hong Jiru greatly feared, followed his plan, spoke to the emperor, and indeed released the Marquis of Biyang.

units.zh: 辟陽侯之囚，欲見平原君，平原君不見辟陽侯，辟陽侯以為倍己，大怒。
units.en: While the Marquis of Biyang was imprisoned, he had sought an audience with the Lord of Pingyuan, but the Lord of Pingyuan refused to see him. The Marquis took this as a betrayal and was furious.
units.literal: When the Marquis of Biyang was imprisoned, he desired to see the Lord of Pingyuan, but the Lord of Pingyuan did not see him. The Marquis of Biyang considered it betrayal and was greatly angered.

units.zh: 及其成功出之，乃大驚。
units.en: When the Lord of Pingyuan had succeeded in getting him released, he was then deeply astonished.
units.literal: When he was successfully released, he was then greatly astonished.

units.zh: 呂太后崩，大臣誅諸呂，辟陽侯於諸呂至深，而卒不誅。
units.en: When the Lü Empress Dowager died, the great ministers executed the Lü clansmen. The Marquis of Biyang was extremely close to them, yet in the end he was not executed.
units.literal: Lü Empress Dowager collapsed, great ministers executed various Lü, Biyang Hou with various Lü extremely deep, yet finally not executed.

units.zh: 計畫所以全者，皆陸生、平原君之力也。
units.en: The stratagems that saved him were entirely the work of Lu Jia and the Lord of Pingyuan.
units.literal: The plans that preserved him were all due to the strength of Lu Jia and the Lord of Pingyuan.

units.zh: 孝文帝時，淮南厲王殺辟陽侯，以諸呂故。
units.en: In Emperor Xiaowen's reign, King Li of Huainan killed the Marquis of Biyang because of the latter's connection to the Lu clansmen.
units.literal: During the Xiaowen Emperor's time, King Li of Huainan killed the Marquis of Biyang because of his ties to the Lü clansmen.

units.zh: 文帝聞其客平原君為計策，使吏捕欲治。
units.en: Emperor Wen heard that his retainer, the Lord of Pingyuan, had devised the plot, and sent officials to arrest him for prosecution.
units.literal: The Wen Emperor heard that his guest, the Lord of Pingyuan, had made the plans, and sent officials to arrest him desiring to punish him.

units.zh: 聞吏至門，平原君欲自殺。
units.en: When he heard the officials at his gate, the Lord of Pingyuan resolved to take his own life.
units.literal: When he heard the officials had arrived at the gate, the Lord of Pingyuan desired to commit suicide.

units.zh: 諸子及吏皆曰：「事未可知，何早自殺為？」
units.en: His sons and officials all said: 'The matter is not yet clear—why commit suicide so early?'
units.literal: Various sons and officials all said: 'Matter not yet knowable, why early suicide do?'

units.zh: 平原君曰：「我死禍絕，不及而身矣。」
units.en: The Lord of Pingyuan said: 'If I die, the calamity ends and will not reach your bodies.'
units.literal: Pingyuan Jun said: 'I die calamity end, not reach your bodies.'

units.zh: 遂自剄。
units.en: He cut his own throat.
units.literal: He then cut his own throat.

units.zh: 孝文帝聞而惜之，曰：「吾無意殺之。」
units.en: The Xiaowen Emperor heard and pitied him, saying: 'I had no intention of killing him.'
units.literal: Xiaowen Emperor heard pitied him, said: 'I no intention kill him.'

units.zh: 乃召其子，拜為中大夫。
units.en: The Emperor summoned his son and appointed him as a Palace Grandee.
units.literal: He then summoned his son and appointed him as Middle Grandee.

units.zh: 使匈奴，單于無禮，乃罵單于，遂死匈奴中。
units.en: He was sent on an embassy to the Xiongnu. When the Chanyu treated him with contempt, he cursed the Chanyu to his face and was put to death among the Xiongnu.
units.literal: He was sent to the Xiongnu. The Chanyu was discourteous, so he cursed the Chanyu and then died among the Xiongnu.

units.zh: 初，沛公引兵過陳留，酈生踵軍門上謁曰：「高陽賤民酈食其，竊聞沛公暴露，將兵助楚討不義，敬勞從者，願得望見，口畫天下便事。」
units.en: Initially, when the Duke of Pei led troops passing through Chenliu, Li Sheng followed to the army gate and ascended to announce: 'I, the humble commoner Li Yiji from Gaoyang, have secretly heard that the Duke of Pei is exposed to the elements, leading troops to assist Chu in attacking the unrighteous. I respectfully labor on behalf of your followers and wish to obtain an audience, to discuss plans useful to the realm.'
units.literal: Initially, Pei Gong led troops passed Chenliu, Li Sheng followed army gate ascended announced said: 'Gaoyang humble commoner Li Yiji, secretly heard Pei Gong exposed, led troops assisted Chu attacked unrighteous, respectfully toiled followers, wish obtain see, mouth plan all-under-heaven convenient matters.'

units.zh: 使者入通，沛公方洗，問使者曰：「何如人也？」
units.en: The envoy entered and announced. The Duke of Pei was just bathing and asked the envoy: 'What kind of person is he?'
units.literal: Envoy entered announced, Pei Gong just bathing, asked envoy said: 'What kind person?'

units.zh: 使者對曰：「狀貌類大儒，衣儒衣，冠側注。」
units.en: The envoy replied: 'In appearance he resembles a great scholar, wearing scholar's clothes with a hat pinned to the side.'
units.literal: Envoy replied said: 'Appearance resembles great scholar, clothes scholar clothes, hat slanted pin.'

units.zh: 沛公曰：「為我謝之，言我方以天下為事，未暇見儒人也。」
units.en: The Duke of Pei said: 'Thank him for me and say that I am just occupied with affairs of the realm and have no leisure to see scholar types.'
units.literal: Pei Gong said: 'For me thank him, say I just with all-under-heaven as affairs, not yet leisure see scholar people.'

units.zh: 使者出謝曰：「沛公敬謝先生，方以天下為事，未暇見儒人也。」
units.en: The envoy exited and thanked him, saying: 'The Duke of Pei respectfully thanks you, Sir. He is just occupied with affairs of the realm and has no leisure to see scholar types.'
units.literal: Envoy exited thanked said: 'Pei Gong respectfully thanks Sir, just with all-under-heaven as affairs, not yet leisure see scholar people.'

units.zh: 酈生瞋目案劍叱使者曰：「走！
units.en: Li Sheng glared with angry eyes, pressed his sword, and berated the envoy: 'Go!
units.literal: Li Sheng glared eyes pressed sword berated envoy said: 'Go!

units.zh: 復入言沛公，吾高陽酒徒也，非儒人也。」
units.en: Go back in and tell the Lord of Pei: I am a wine-drinker from Gaoyang, not a scholar.'
units.literal: Go back in and tell the Lord of Pei, "I am a wine-drinker from Gaoyang, not a scholar."'

units.zh: 使者懼而失謁，跪拾謁，還走，復入報曰：「客，天下壯士也，叱臣，臣恐，至失謁。
units.en: The envoy, frightened, dropped the announcement tablet, kneeled to pick it up, ran back, and re-entered to report: "The guest is one of the realm's heroic men. He berated me, and I was so frightened that I dropped the announcement tablet.
units.literal: Envoy feared dropped announcement, kneeled picked announcement, returned ran, again entered reported said: "Guest, all-under-heaven heroic man, berated minister, minister feared, to dropped announcement.

units.zh: 曰『走！
units.en: He said 'Go!
units.literal: Said 'Go!

units.zh: 復入言，而公高陽酒徒也』。」
units.en: Go back in and tell him: I am a wine-drinker from Gaoyang.'"
units.literal: Go back in and tell him, 'I am a wine-drinker from Gaoyang.'"

units.zh: 沛公遽雪足杖矛曰：「延客入！」
units.en: The Duke of Pei hastily wiped his feet, leaned on his spear, and said: 'Invite the guest to enter!'
units.literal: Pei Gong hastily wiped feet leaned spear said: 'Invite guest enter!'

units.zh: 酈生入，揖沛公曰：「足下甚苦，暴衣露冠，將兵助楚討不義，足不何不自喜也？
units.en: Li Sheng entered and bowed to the Duke of Pei, saying: "Your Excellency suffers greatly, with exposed clothes and bared hat, leading troops to assist Chu in attacking the unrighteous. Why do you not rejoice in yourself?
units.literal: Li Sheng entered, bowed Pei Gong said: "Your Excellency very bitter, exposed clothes bared hat, leading troops assisted Chu attacked unrighteous, why not self rejoice?

units.zh: 臣願以事見，而曰『吾方以天下為事，未暇見儒人也』。
units.en: I wished to be seen because of affairs, yet you said, 'I am just occupied with affairs of the realm and have no leisure to see scholar types.'
units.literal: Minister wished with affairs see, yet said 'I just with all-under-heaven as affairs, not yet leisure see scholar people'.

units.zh: 夫足下欲興天下之大事而成天下之大功，而以目皮相，恐失天下之能士。
units.en: Now Your Excellency desires to raise the realm's great enterprise and complete the realm's great achievements, yet you judge superficially with your eyes and risk losing the ablest scholars in the world.
units.literal: Now Your Excellency desires raise all-under-heaven's great affairs and complete all-under-heaven's great merit, yet with eyes superficially view, fear lose all-under-heaven's able scholars.

units.zh: 且吾度足下之智不如吾，勇又不如吾。
units.en: Moreover, I judge that Your Excellency's wisdom does not equal mine, and your courage does not equal mine either.
units.literal: Moreover, I measure Your Excellency's wisdom not equal mine, courage moreover not equal mine.

units.zh: 若欲就天下而不相見，竊為足下失之。」
units.en: If you desire to complete the affairs of the realm without seeing me, I privately consider it a loss for Your Excellency."
units.literal: If desire complete all-under-heaven not mutually see, secretly for Your Excellency lose it."

units.zh: 沛公謝曰：「鄉者聞先生之容，今見先生之意矣。」
units.en: The Duke of Pei apologized and said: 'Formerly I heard of your appearance, Sir; now I see your intent.'
units.literal: Pei Gong apologized said: 'Formerly heard Sir's appearance, now see Sir's intent.'

units.zh: 乃延而坐之，問所以取天下者。
units.en: He invited Li Yiji to sit down and asked him how to win the empire.
units.literal: He then invited him to sit and asked how to take all under heaven.

units.zh: 酈生曰：「夫足下欲成大功，不如止陳留。
units.en: Li Sheng said: 'Your Excellency desires to complete great merit. Nothing equals stopping at Chenliu.
units.literal: Li Sheng said: 'Now Your Excellency desires complete great merit, not equal stop Chenliu.

units.zh: 陳留者，天下之據衝也，兵之會地也，積粟數千萬石，城守甚堅。
units.en: Chenliu is the realm's strategic point, the place where troops assemble. It has accumulated grain of several tens of millions of shi, and its city defenses are very firm.
units.literal: Chenliu is all-under-heaven's strategic point, troops' assembly place, accumulated grain several thousand ten thousand shi, city defense very firm.

units.zh: 臣素善其令，願為足下說之。
units.en: I have long been on good terms with the magistrate there. Allow me to go and persuade him on your behalf.
units.literal: I have always been on good terms with its magistrate; I wish to persuade him for Your Excellency.

units.zh: 不聽臣，臣請為足下殺之，而下陳留。
units.en: If he does not listen to me, I ask your leave to kill him and take Chenliu.
units.literal: If he does not listen to me, I request to kill him for Your Excellency and take Chenliu.

units.zh: 足下將陳留之眾，據陳留之城，而食其積粟，招天下之從兵；
units.en: Your Excellency can lead Chenliu's multitudes, occupy Chenliu's city, eat its accumulated grain, and recruit allied troops from all quarters;
units.literal: Your Excellency lead Chenliu's multitudes, occupy Chenliu's city, eat its accumulated grain, recruit all-under-heaven's following troops;

units.zh: 從兵已成，足下橫行天下，莫能有害足下者矣。」
units.en: Once the allied troops are formed, Your Excellency can traverse the realm, and none will be able to harm you.'
units.literal: Following troops already formed, Your Excellency traverse all-under-heaven, none able harm Your Excellency.'

units.zh: 沛公曰：「敬聞命矣。」
units.en: The Duke of Pei said: 'I respectfully hear your command.'
units.literal: Pei Gong said: 'Respectfully hear command.'

units.zh: 於是酈生乃夜見陳留令，說之曰：「夫秦為無道而天下畔之，今足下與天下從則可以成大功。
units.en: Li Sheng then went by night to see the Chenliu magistrate and persuaded him, saying: 'Qin acts without righteousness, and the whole realm rebels against it. Now if Your Excellency follows the realm, you can complete great merit.
units.literal: Thereupon Li Sheng then night saw Chenliu magistrate, persuaded him said: 'Now Qin does unrighteous all-under-heaven rebels it, now Your Excellency with all-under-heaven follow then can complete great merit.

units.zh: 今獨為亡秦嬰城而堅守，臣竊為足下危之。」
units.en: Now to alone embrace the city and firmly guard it for the perished Qin—I secretly consider it dangerous for Your Excellency.'
units.literal: Now alone for perished Qin embrace city firmly guard, minister secretly for Your Excellency endanger it.'

units.zh: 陳留令曰：「秦法至重也，不可以妄言，妄言者無類，吾不可以應。
units.en: The Chenliu magistrate said: 'Qin's laws are extremely heavy. One cannot speak recklessly; reckless speakers are executed along with their kin. I cannot respond.
units.literal: Chenliu magistrate said: 'Qin laws extremely heavy, not can reckless speak, reckless speakers no kin, I not can respond.

units.zh: 先生所以教臣者，非臣之意也，願勿復道。」
units.en: What you teach me, Sir, is not my intent. I wish you not to speak of it again.'
units.literal: Sir what teach minister, not minister's intent, wish not again speak.'

units.zh: 酈生留宿臥，夜半時斬陳留令首，踰城而下報沛公。
units.en: Li Yiji stayed the night. At midnight, he cut off the head of the Chenliu magistrate, scaled the city wall, and went to report to the Lord of Pei.
units.literal: Li Sheng stayed overnight and slept. At midnight he cut off the Chenliu magistrate's head, climbed over the wall, descended, and reported to the Duke of Pei.

units.zh: 沛公引兵攻城，縣令首於長竿以示城上人，曰：「趣下，而令頭已斷矣！
units.en: The Duke of Pei led troops to attack the city, hung the magistrate's head on a long pole to show the people on the city walls, and said: 'Hurry and surrender! Your magistrate's head has already been cut off!
units.literal: Pei Gong led troops attacked city, hung magistrate head on long pole to show city upper people, said: 'Hurry descend, your magistrate head already cut!

units.zh: 今後下者必先斬之！」
units.en: Anyone who surrenders later will certainly be beheaded first!'
units.literal: Now later surrenderers must first cut them!'

units.zh: 於是陳留人見令已死，遂相率而下沛公。
units.en: When the people of Chenliu saw that their magistrate was dead, they rallied together and surrendered to the Lord of Pei.
units.literal: Thereupon the people of Chenliu saw that their magistrate was already dead, so they led each other in surrendering to the Duke of Pei.

units.zh: 沛公舍陳留南城門上，因其庫兵，食積粟，留出入三月，從兵以萬數，遂入破秦。
units.en: The Lord of Pei quartered himself above the south gate of Chenliu. He seized the city's arsenal and weapons, drew on its stores of grain, and remained there for three months, coming and going freely. His following swelled to tens of thousands of soldiers, and he marched west with them to destroy Qin.
units.literal: The Lord of Pei lodged above Chenliu's south gate, took its arsenal and weapons, ate the accumulated grain, and remained there three months coming and going. His following troops numbered in the tens of thousands, and he then marched in to destroy Qin.

units.zh: 太史公曰：世之傳酈生書，多曰漢王已拔三秦，東擊項籍而引軍於鞏洛之閒，酈生被儒衣往說漢王。
units.en: The Grand Historian says: The world's transmitted books about Li Sheng mostly say that the Han King had already taken the Three Qins, attacked Xiang Ji to the east, and was leading his army between Gong and Luo when Li Sheng, wearing scholar's clothes, went to persuade the Han King.
units.literal: Grand Historian said: World's transmitted Li Sheng books, many said Han King already pulled San Qin, east attacked Xiang Ji then led army at Gong Luo between, Li Sheng wore scholar clothes went persuaded Han King.

units.zh: 乃非也。
units.en: This is not so.
units.literal: This is incorrect.

units.zh: 自沛公未入關，與項羽別而至高陽，得酈生兄弟。
units.en: Before the Lord of Pei had entered the passes, after parting ways with Xiang Yu, he came to Gaoyang and gained the services of the Li Yiji brothers.
units.literal: Before the Duke of Pei had entered the pass, after separating from Xiang Yu, he arrived at Gaoyang and obtained the Li Sheng brothers.

units.zh: 余讀陸生新語書十二篇，固當世之辯士。
units.en: I have read Lu Jia's book of New Sayings in twelve chapters; he was indeed the eloquent scholar of his age.
units.literal: I read Lu Sheng New Sayings book twelve chapters, indeed current age's eloquent scholar.

units.zh: 至平原君子與余善，是以得具論之。
units.en: As for the Lord of Pingyuan, his son was a friend of mine, which is how I was able to set down the full account.
units.literal: As for the Lord of Pingyuan, his son was on good terms with me, which is why I was able to discuss it fully.
